name: add_contact
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: Add a new contact.

name: add_label
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: Add a label (folder membership) to an email.

label.description: The folder/label name to add (e.g. "starred", "important", or a system folder name).

name: archive_email
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: Archive an email by removing it from the inbox folder.

name: create_draft
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: Create a new email draft.

name: forward_email
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: Forward an email to new recipients.

name: get_email
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: Retrieve the full content of a single email by its ID.

email_id.description: The unique identifier of the email.

name: get_thread
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: Retrieve all emails in a conversation thread.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: thread_id (str), subject (str), emails (List[Dict]) — in chronological order.

name: list_contacts
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: List all contacts.

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: Contact objects with name and email_address.

name: list_emails
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: List emails in a given folder.

max_results.description: Maximum number of emails to return. Defaults to 20.

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: Email objects sorted by created_at descending.

name: mark_as_read
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: Mark an email as read.

email_id.description: The email to mark as read.

name: mark_as_unread
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: Mark an email as unread.

email_id.description: The email to mark as unread.

name: remove_label
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: Remove a label (folder membership) from an email.

name: reply_to_email
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: Reply to an existing email. The reply is added to the same thread.

reply_all.description: If True, reply to all recipients. Defaults to False.

name: search_emails
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: Search emails using Gmail-style query operators: from:, to:, subject:, has:attachment, label:, is:unread, is:starred, is:important. Free text is matched against subject and body.

query.description: Search query string. Examples: "from:alice@example.com subject:meeting" "has:attachment label:inbox" "is:unread is:starred" "quarterly report" (free text)

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: Matching email objects sorted by created_at descending.

name: send_draft
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: Send a previously created draft. The draft is removed after sending.

name: send_email
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: Compose and send an email immediately.

name: star_email
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: Star an email.

name: switch_user
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: Switch the active user account.

username.description: The username to switch to. Must exist in the users dict.

name: trash_email
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: Move an email to Trash, removing it from all other folders.

name: unstar_email
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: Remove the star from an email.

name: update_draft
description: This tool belongs to the Gmail API, which provides functionality for sending, receiving, and organizing emails using a label-based system with thread-based conversation grouping. Tool description: Update an existing draft with new content.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: The updated draft object.
